name: Is a Luxury Condo CMA the same as an appraisal?

mainEntity.name: Is a Luxury Condo CMA the same as an appraisal?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, a Luxury Condo CMA is not the same as an appraisal. A CMA is an informal estimate of value prepared by a real estate agent to help guide pricing for a sale. An appraisal is a formal, legally binding valuation performed by a licensed appraiser, often required by lenders for financing. While both assess value, an appraisal adheres to stricter regulatory guidelines and typically involves a fee. The CMA by our team serves as an effective pre-listing tool for strategic pricing.
